serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Cashier.Face.happyAlt
Real Melissa: I’m back, Amei!
Amei: Welcome back, mistress!
Real Melissa: Aw, come on! I told you to call me by my name! We have known each other since I was 13!
Amei: Sorry about that.
Real Melissa: I don’t have much homework today so how about we go to the movies?
Amei: Mistress Melissa does realize that we have a cinema at home, right?
Real Melissa: I do~ but it isn’t the same as going out~
Amei: Alright. I will contact your father to inform him of our actions and then we can go, ok?
Real Melissa: Yay! Thank you for spoiling me~
Amei: That’s what I’m here for, after all.
Real Melissa: Alright then! Let’s pick out some cute clothes. We can’t go out like this!
#Cashier.Eyes.happyClosed+Cashier.Mouth.grin
Amei: Sure!
